countingRules.documentedEntries: All entries in the existing source atlas: menus, fields, value choices and reference rows. This is not an emulator screen count.
countingRules.reachableEmulatorNodes: Unique model node IDs reachable from at least one configured access root, including conditional choice branches. Shared nodes and repeated record instances are counted once.
countingRules.editableSettingNodes: Reachable choice, numeric, text and independent-flag fields. The same field edited for different zones/users/groups is counted once.
countingRules.operationalAndStatusNodes: Reachable action, omit, zone display, event log, walk test/results, output test and read-only status handlers.
countingRules.referenceOnlyNodes: Reachable source-labelled info nodes with no claimed physical interaction. A source reference does not establish complete emulation fidelity.
countingRules.physicalScreens: Not measured or claimed. No manufacturer firmware or physical panel is running.

auditCorrections: Galaxy Force V.21 remains unavailable on internal and external Telecom; no invented 0/1 editor.
External Telecom Fail to Communicate retains attempt-count semantics without an invented range; Backup Module retains its distinct documented ordering.
Trigger and group record selection precedes the dependent Status/Groups or Telephone/Account fields.
Galaxy PA Delay, Part Alarm, Power Delay, Delay Alarm and Fail to Set preserve separate per-group values.
Galaxy Set Override/Reset Levels fault categories are separate fields, not mutually exclusive values for the whole parameter.
Galaxy Key/SW Level conflict is retained as an evidence gap instead of reusing another parameter’s accepted range.
Source editions, Quick Menu slots, Scantronic configuration modes and duplicate option numbers remain explicitly separated.
limitations: The app is a local training simulation with fictional devices and values. It has no panel transport or physical signalling.
Exact firmware timing, every confirmation sequence, manufacturer text libraries and the complete LCD rendering are not reproduced.
The source atlas retains 36 evidence questions. Additional info screens identify behaviour whose editor or sequence is not verified.
Stored settings train programming and selection; not every stored setting changes the simulated alarm behaviour.
No physical keypad, panel or native mobile device has been verified for this report.

Texecom per-zone Yes/No edit, cancel and next field
